name: Key Woodworking, Inc.
old_description: Keywood has been serving the DMV area projects since 1992 with passion.
about:
Key Woodworking, Inc., based in Springfield, Virginia, was founded in 1992 by a first-generation immigrant who began as a one-man woodworking shop. The company remains a small business serving the Washington, D.C. metro area.

The firm specializes in custom-fabricated premium architectural woodwork for commercial projects, with a focus on upscale high-rise multi-residential buildings and Class A office towers. It provides engineering services to align design intent with fabrication, and sources wood products globally from Europe, Africa, and Asia. The shop has executed single contracts exceeding $2 million under tight deadlines.

Key Woodworking serves designers, contractors, and owners in sectors including multi-residential construction, office construction, restaurants, and public institutions. Its project portfolio includes amenity spaces, lobbies, and lounges throughout the DMV region.

The company emphasizes values of honesty, hard work, and innovation, citing pride in dedication, finely tuned scheduling, open communication, project ownership, and innovative solutions as differentiators.
